universe.filter: Country=United States; nonempty Sector; name contains common stock/common shares; alphabetic symbol; no current status filter

price_source: Alpaca SIP raw; asof=2025-04-25 fixes symbol identity, not adjustment chronology
source_daily_volume: May include extended hours; used only as liquidity upper bound for safe prefilter, never substituted into final regular-session AVWAP/liquidity
prefilter: Use daily OHLC for price/ADR/momentum/EMA/higher-low/first-pullback conditions and all-session volume upper bound, before fetching full RTH five-minute histories. No trades or outcomes used. Validate daily OHLC against RTH aggregation before a result is treated as a faithful replay.
five_minute: Continuous positive-volume RTH five-minute bars. No forward fill. Missing held-position bars halt certified NAV and are reported. Prospective candidate gaps reject that signal; no ex-post full-day entry filter.
signal_availability: bar end + 1 second, modeled, not measured
entry_model: First subsequent five-minute bar OPEN strictly after signal available_at and before five-minute expiration; adverse price <= buy limit required; no intrabar touch fills; never fill signal bar; conditional OHLC proxy not an execution guarantee
partial_and_stop: Frozen manage() stop-first OHLC convention; market-triggered partial at 3R less cost, not a limit fill claim
portfolio: One shared cash/equity pool; existing holdings and pending entries reserve capacity; deterministic watchlist order; no same-symbol same-session reentry
actions: As-of-effective-date split adjustment for signals and held share/stop adjustments; cash dividends accrue on ex-date and become spendable only at payable date. Missing/ambiguous mergers, fractional cash-in-lieu or delisting settlement block complete-accounting claims.
end_of_period: Mark open holdings at last regular close; do not force an unexecutable closing sale; report unrealized PnL separately
gates: complete dynamic point-in-time membership and sectors
corporate action and delisting settlement completeness
